changes.before: true = persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive restarts. false (default) = in-memory only, dies when this Claude session ends. Use true only when the user asks the task to survive across sessions.
changes.after: true = persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive restarts (the result says Session-only if the job could not be saved). false (default) = in-memory only, dies when this Claude session ends. Use true only when the user asks the task to survive across sessions.

changes.before: true (default) = fire on every cron match until deleted or auto-expired after 7 days. false = fire once at the next match, then auto-delete. Use false for "remind me at X" one-shot requests with pinned minute/hour/dom/month.
changes.after: true (default) = fire on every cron match until deleted or auto-expired after 30 days. false = fire once at the next match, then auto-delete. Use false for "remind me at X" one-shot requests with pinned minute/hour/dom/month.
Age at which a recurring job ends; 0 = never

summary.headline: Claude Code 2.1.330 changed the instructions of 1 built-in tool (CronCreate).
